E01.required_evidence: Public dataset citation, release identity, and selected-dataset declaration
E01.requirement: At least one public real LiDAR data source is required for supplementary external validation.

E02.documented_limitation_semantics: PASS_WITH_DOCUMENTED_LIMITATION does not assert that the static extrinsic is non-LiDAR, fully independent, or uncertainty-free. It permits only supplementary external trend/generalization validation under every listed limitation.

conditions.requirement: The static extrinsic is not re-estimated in this experiment.
The static extrinsic is not re-estimated for the primary or reserve pair.
The static extrinsic is not re-estimated from weak/rich labels.
The static extrinsic is not re-estimated from Open3D or PCL results.
The static extrinsic does not use any query-to-target registration output from this experiment.
Every evaluated sequence uses the same frozen byte-identical matrix.
The complete LiDAR-assisted calibration provenance is disclosed.
Unknown calibration session, calibration date, or query participation remains UNKNOWN.
When extrinsic uncertainty is unknown, no absolute metrological conclusion below reference uncertainty is permitted.
The static extrinsic is used only for external trend/generalization validation.

E02.requirement: The reference trajectory backbone must be independent of the evaluated query-to-target scan-to-map registration and must not be produced by ICP, scan matching, LiDAR odometry, or SLAM.

E03.required_evidence: Frozen query and target-map construction lineage
E03.requirement: An evaluated query scan must not be used to construct its own target map.

E04.requirement: The target map and query scan must come from different Boreas sequences.

E05.required_evidence: Timestamp provenance, calibration provenance, and transform chain
E05.requirement: The timestamp chain and extrinsic chain must be auditable.

E06.requirement: After a successful Boreas Stage-2, freeze 10 weak intervals with 5 snapshots each and 10 rich intervals with 5 snapshots each, yielding 50 weak snapshots, 50 rich snapshots, 100 snapshots total, and 200 backend trials.

E07.required_evidence: Immutable pre-registration interval and label manifest
E07.requirement: Every weak/rich label must be frozen before any real registration is run.

E08.requirement: Open3D and PCL must consume byte-identical canonical input.

E09.requirement: Retain the frozen Open3D and PCL backend parameter contract without Boreas-specific ICP parameters.

E10.requirement: Record every listed reference, timing, calibration, interpolation, deskew, and map-accumulation uncertainty component.

E11.requirement: Boreas v2 does not require an observed effect to exceed every real-reference uncertainty and cannot supply the primary metrological gate.
E11.small_or_comparable_update_interpretatio: If an update is smaller than or comparable to reference uncertainty, it is only a descriptive registration update and is not a physical localization error resolved by independent truth.

E12.requirement: Continuous displacement, rotation, and association metrics are primary; one arbitrary success threshold must not replace the result.

E13.requirement: Association and reassociation metrics must reuse the frozen offline common-association definition.

E14.requirement: The primary pair, reserve pairs, scene intervals, weak/rich labels, and snapshots must not be reselected after registration results are observed.

purpose: Check whether additional scan-to-map registration updates initialized from reference pose, geometry dependence, cross-backend trends, and correspondence reassociation in a public independent-acquisition fixed-world-frame mobile dataset are directionally consistent with controlled synthetic results.
